briefdescription.para: Compile-time xterm-256 color palette for terminal color resolution.

detaileddescription.para: Defines the complete 256-entry xterm color table as constexpr data, partitioned into three canonical segments:
All tables are inline const (juce::Colour lacks constexpr constructors). Helper functions are inline. No heap allocation occurs.

simplesect.para: Include this header wherever SGR color attribute 38;5;n or 48;5;n sequences must be resolved to an RGB triple. Use palette256At(n) for index lookup.
